reviews.text: This was the third Vet I have tried since moving back to Texas.  All of the ladies there were incredibly nice and weren’t afraid of my Large dog. I could tell he was comfortable and happy to be treated like the good boy he is.
Very easy appointment, straightforward pricing. I was able to make a last minute appointment and get my girl checked out the next day. Labs were super quick and the staff is really nice.

Real real rude — was talking to a lady about putting our 15 year old golden down and after the appt was set. They called back and demanded to pay in full before they arrived and before I could reply mentioned giving me other numbers to call other places to handle this. After I even said I would pay in full.
We’re glad to know you had a great experience, Faith. It means a lot to the team to earn your 5-star support.
We appreciate the 5-star rating, Valonda, and it means a lot to know you took the time to share it. The Petfolk Team
Vet tech and doctor were pleasant, informative, knowledgeable and so gentle and kind with our dog.

We just moved to the area and needed quick vet care.    I was able to get our girl Luna seen right away and the staff were amazing!   We have a nervous dog and they took the extra care to let her get to know them.    I’m very happy with our experience and will continue to use Petfolk as our regular vet!!
Tucker had a great experience at pet folk today. The staff was very kind and the vet was very knowledgeable. I would recommend petfolk to anyone who needs pet care. 5 stars in my book...

Had a great first experience with Petfolk @ Lakewood. We were able to schedule everything on line at 10:00am Sunday and got an appointment same day at 12pm. No wait when we arrived and doctor saw us right away. Our vet and techs are great helping our senior dog. Explain everything and transparent with pricing.

They were so nice and so helpful, as well as very upfront with the cost. The membership is worth it to be honest and more than pays for itself. I am incredibly grateful I was able to book a last minute appointment on a Saturday no less!

Everyone at this location has been beyond compassionate and went above and beyond in attempting to help us after we rushed in with my fur nephew. Not even being an emergency facility they still rushed to help us
After he passed they helped arrange his cremation and told us to call if we ever need anything or even if we are simply sad. The comfort provided in this sad situation is why our pets are now petfolk pets ❤️‍🩹

Seeing a 5-star note like this is always encouraging for our team at Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - Lakewood. It tells us the care, communication, and follow-through are landing the right way, and that matters to everyone who helps make the visit smooth.

We've been struggling to get to the bottom of our 12-year-old terrier mix Troy's illness for over a month now, including two visits to Banfield. When he started having labored breathing today, we brought him into Petfolk Lakewood and were so glad we did. The tech spent a lot of time with us and, along with Dr. Kim, gave us a thorough, clear explanation of what was going on. The facility itself is clean and welcoming, but what really stood out was how invested the whole team seemed in getting Troy feeling better — it didn't feel rushed or transactional at all. Highly recommend if you want a vet team that actually takes the time with you and your pet.

Bad Experience. These guys botched my cat's euthanasia. Her passing was not peaceful, but filled with fear and pain. The sedation did not go as promised. After 8 minutes my cat starting showing signs of distress and vomiting. They had to sedate her a second time. By then she was terrified, screeching, and hissing. It was  very difficult to witness. It was not what I wanted for her. On top of that, they promised to wash the towel in her carrier that she vomited on. They said I could pick it up when I picked up her memorial paws print. They lost it instead. I neither recommend, nor would I go back to this place.

Went to Petfolk for my cat Luna who is having trouble with her eyes. The employees and vet there were amazing and kind. They helped us out so much in making sure that our cat is ok.

Definitely 100% will be coming back again :)
Sweetest ppl that you will ever meet, HIGHLY Recommend

Best vet experience ive had. They give you all the information you could need and then some, they make sure you understand everything going on with your pet and the best care options. 10/10 would recommemd
The vet and staff were so kind. Everything was explained really well to me and I left with a clear understanding of the plan for my dog. This was my second time coming here and it is amazing.
I had a wonderful experience today at Petfolk. The took such great care of my dog, they were kind, patient and knowledgeable. Looking forward to carrying on with them for my veterinary needs.
Got all 3 of my cats seen here. Very kind and knowledgeable staff. Never a wait to be seen, same day appointments, and reasonably priced.
Top tier Knowledgeable Vet techs. Kind and warming.
We had a wonderful experience with Petfolk! They were extremely welcoming and comforting to our pup! ♥️

Very Disappointing and Disorganized Experience

I had a disappointing experience with this veterinary clinic.

My cat had already undergone multiple urinalyses, a urine culture, and bloodwork, and we had scheduled her bladder stone removal surgery based on the results and our discussion with her veterinarian.

On the day of surgery, I was suddenly told that they wanted to repeat her bloodwork because her calcium had been elevated on the original lab work. This was particularly frustrating because this had never been brought to my attention when we reviewed her initial bloodwork. They wanted to perform more expensive in-house testing at the last minute, delaying the procedure.

After the new bloodwork came back, they told us they would not perform the surgery. I explained that the veterinarian we had originally been working with had told us that her calcium levels were fine. We were then told that the new surgeon disagreed, and the situation was essentially presented as a disagreement between their own doctors.

When we came to pick up our cat, we were presented with a bill for approximately $600 for additional bloodwork and X-rays. We had never consented to the X-rays. When we asked why they had been performed, we were told they were done in preparation for surgery, despite the fact that we had already been told that additional bloodwork needed to be completed before surgery could proceed. To their credit, they ultimately removed the X-ray charge after we explained that we had not authorized the procedure, but we were still charged for the additional bloodwork.

The entire process felt extremely disorganized and unnecessarily stressful. My partner had taken an entire day off work for the surgery, only for us to find out that the procedure would not be performed that day.

We immediately found another veterinarian who was able to see our cat the following day. We provided them with the bloodwork performed on the day of the scheduled surgery, and they reviewed it and determined that her calcium was not elevated enough to prevent surgery. They were able to schedule her bladder stone surgery that same day.

Ultimately, this experience caused a significant amount of unnecessary stress for both our cat and our family. I understand that medical decisions can change and that veterinarians may have different clinical opinions. What was most disappointing was the lack of communication, the last-minute changes, the lack of clarity about what procedures we were consenting to, and the fact that we had to find another veterinarian to get the care our cat needed.

Unfortunately, the experience left me feeling that the clinic was more focused on billing and procedures than on providing coordinated, pet-centered care. Based on our experience, I would not recommend this clinic.
needed some quick help with stomach issues in my black lab until we could get to our vet on Monday.  They took care to explain everything and got her feeling better on Sunday !
Kind and knowledgeable!
Clean organized and friendly. Our Bernese mountain dog especially enjoyed the salmon treats.
A very clean, professional, and compassionate place. They are thourough and communicate every step and possibility. I couldnt be happier with my decision to trust them with my Odd ball.

We’re glad the visit left such a positive impression.

Our Lakewood team works to make care straightforward and reassuring, so it is encouraging to know that came through in your experience.

We look forward to continuing that standard at future visits.

A 5-star rating tells us the visit left a strong impression. At Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - Lakewood, we aim to keep care clear, efficient, and reassuring from start to finish, so it is encouraging to know that came through in your experience.
The staff members are sweet and have great customer service!

I've never left a Google review, but I felt this situation warranted it! Our puppy is a bit of a mess, and he's had numerous medical issues since we got him, from recurrent ear infections, to Giardia, to allergies, ranging to his most recent escapade after his neuter, where he's chewed through six cones, ended up in the ER for a possible obstruction, and trucked through rather large amounts of sedatives as we've changed his meds as his body adapted to the medicines in an effort to keep him calm enough to heal. Throughout this whole process, Petfolk, with Dr. Soltys and her team, has been amazing. Their app allows for messages to be sent at odd hours to save us visits if needed, and they've been immensely supportive, providing near-daily changes in management, medications, cones, and wound checks. They've made a very difficult situation more feasible to navigate, and my wife and I can't really express enough how glad we are to have them to take care of our puppy. Can't recommend them highly enough!

A 5-star visit like this tells us the team delivered the kind of care people expect from Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - Lakewood.

We’re glad the experience felt smooth and reassuring, and we’ll keep aiming for that same standard in every visit.

They explained all treatment and payment options, without trying to over treat or upsale. I'm grateful that my fur son is going to be ok and that we were handled with care.

got in right away. very kind, explained every step w a price point. it feels sterile in the best way possible. having had some tough vet experiences i am delighted to find one I am comfortable taking my cats to.
Great knowledge and care. Was provided the same amount of love I give my pup. She was happy visiting. Knew she was safe and in good hands.
Great very helpful and quick
Team and staff did a wonderful job helping us in such a difficult time. Super nice and helpful.

Very knowledgeable and they were able to get us in same day for an emergency. Highly recommend
friendly staff

This Vet never saw my dog is quoting me the highest on an overpriced surgery. My little dog has cancer and have had X-rays and bloodwork done for what they charged of 700.00 at Notrth dallas Clinic on Campbell Road and Preston. I prefer that location Drs and staff much more. I was told by a friend who owns a rescue my quote was too high, they graciously adjusted the expense but could not see my dog for a week as surgeries are backed up. They want an additional 140.00 exam fee, they wanted an additional 300.00 for the surgery, I asked for a manager, they said they did not have one yet would not waive additional costs. I don’t think this is fair and that the additional 616.00 should be enough for her tumor to be removed.
